scope: Seed-owned source constraints for the two legacy permission names already referenced by signed release 20

definitions.rationale: Read-source catalog constraints only. BP target read authority and stored parent ownership remain mandatory. This definition does not authorize comment creation, editing, deletion or reactions.
Legacy BP attachment-summary source constraints only. This is not an alias for neon.collaboration.attachment.read. Stored attachment/resource admission and download controls remain independent.

effectiveAccessImpact: Existing target-granted reads can move from unavailable to allowed once source conditions are evaluable. This is a policy decision even with zero grant mutations.
sourceDenialsAndConditions: Current source denials, module entitlement, assurance and policy conditions remain checked on the same resolved resource. No missing definition is treated as satisfied.
publication: Catalog hash and authenticated runtime review must be refreshed in a compatible successor; historical release-20 approval receipts are not reusable as approval of this catalog revision.
